card.title: PlayStation 5 RTC Battery and 32kHz Clock Drain Troubleshooting

claims.statement: The 3V real-time clock battery runs the 32kHz oscillator for the Southbridge.
claims.evidence: Voltage drop across the 1k resistor must be low; otherwise, a short is draining the clock battery, which may indicate a faulty Southbridge.
claims.quote: Battery +3V Battery for real time clock it runs the 32Khz oscillator for the southbridge If battery is empty 1k resistor Voltage drop must be low, else there is a short draining the clock battery, maybe southbridge is fa

card.caveats: Always verify the voltage drop across the 1k resistor to detect any short circuit conditions draining the clock battery.
